camel_example: aliyun dyvmsapi CloudCreateAgent --region cn-hangzhou --Cno 1111 --AreaCode 010 --EnterpriseId 7000002 --Name '张三' --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
name: CloudCreateAgent

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access address
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The agent number. The value must be a positive integer of 3 to 10 digits
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号；正整数，取值3-10位数字
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The agent name. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format
parameters.help_zh: 座席姓名；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The area code of the agent
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属区号
parameters.name: area_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to activate the agent. Valid values:
0: not activated.
1: activated.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否激活；取值0或1，取值说明 0：不激活，1激活，默认激活
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en:
The permission level of the agent. Valid values:
0: regular agent.
1: supervisor.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 座席权限；取值1或0，取值说明 1：班长席，0：普通座席，默认为0 普通座席
parameters.name: power

parameters.help_en:
The call permission of the agent. Valid values:
0: no restrictions.
1: domestic long-distance calls.
2: local calls within the city.
3: internal calls only.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫权限；取值说明 0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
parameters.name: call_power

parameters.help_en: The wrap-up time, in seconds. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 整理时间；单位秒数，默认10秒
parameters.name: wrapup

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow outbound calls. Valid values:
0: not allowed.
1: allowed.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许外呼；取值说明 0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
parameters.name: is_ob

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID display rule for outbound calls. Valid values:
1: default.
2: random.
3: by area code.
4: dynamic caller ID display.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外显规则；取值：1:默认 2:随机 3:按区号 4 动态外显 ，默认值为1
parameters.name: ob_clid_type

parameters.help_en: The pass-through number. You can specify an enterprise trunk number or a preconfigured customer-side caller ID number. This parameter is required when ObClidType is set to 2 or 3
parameters.help_zh: 透传号码；可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码，当obClidType值为2或3时必选
parameters.name: ob_clid

parameters.help_en: The caller ID display properties. Example: {"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1,"isRandom":1}. This parameter takes effect when ObClidType is set to 4. isMatchCapital specifies whether to match provincial capital numbers. Valid values: 1 (yes) and 0 (no). areaCodeRule specifies the area code matching rule. Valid values: 1 (agent area code) and 2 (customer number area code). isRandom specifies whether to use random caller ID display
parameters.help_zh: 外显属性；取值：{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1,"isRandom":1}；obClidType=4时，isMatchCapital表示是否匹配省会号码，1是 0否，areaCodeRule表示区号匹配规则，1座席区号 2客户号码区号 ;isRandom 随机外显
parameters.name: ob_clid_property

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record inbound calls. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 呼入是否录音；取值说明 0：不录用，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ib_record

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record outbound calls. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外呼是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ob_record

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the skills assigned to the agent. You can specify multiple skill IDs separated by commas, for example, "1,2,3". If you specify SkillIds, you must also specify SkillLevels
parameters.help_zh: 所选的技能id；可选择多个，多个之间使用英文标点逗号间隔.例如:"1,2,3"；传入skillIds时，需要同时传入skillLevels
parameters.name: skill_ids

parameters.help_en: The levels of the assigned skills. A lower value indicates a higher skill level. Specify multiple levels separated by commas, in the same order as the corresponding skill IDs. For example, "5,1,1" means skill ID 1 has level 5, skill ID 2 has level 1, and skill ID 3 has level 1
parameters.help_zh: 所选的技能的等级；值越小技能越高，多个间用英文标点逗号间隔。(与技能id相对应) 例如:"5,1,1"表示技能id为1的等级是5; 技能id为2的等级是1; 技能id为3的等级是1
parameters.name: skill_levels

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcription. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启ASR转写；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启
parameters.name: is_asr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable agent quality inspection. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启座席质检；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认开启
parameters.name: is_quality_check

parameters.help_en:
The return address type for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values:
0: enterprise default.
1: public domain name.
2: dedicated line domain name.
3: public IP address.
4: dedicated line IP address
parameters.help_zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
parameters.name: webrtc_url_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable outbound caller ID memory. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外呼主叫记忆开关；取值说明：0：关闭 1：开启；默认开启
parameters.name: is_ob_remember

parameters.help_en: The remarks
parameters.help_zh: 备注
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The permitted time range for outbound calls. Format: 08:00,20:00
parameters.name: permit_ob_preview_time
